tool.name: Suggest Connectors
tool.description: Suggest one or more connector providers by rendering connector cards inline in chat (via render_widget). Creates or reuses a saved widget with a deterministic slug.

nodes.name: Validate Input
nodes.description: Normalize providers and compute deterministic widget slug

nodes.name: Fetch Connector Catalog
nodes.description: Fetch connector catalog to map provider -> display name

nodes.name: Build Widget Meta
nodes.description: Build widget name/description using connector display names

nodes.name: Search Widgets
nodes.description: Look up existing widget by deterministic slug

nodes.name: Extract Found Widget
nodes.description: Extract first widget if it exists, else null

nodes.name: Widget exists?
nodes.description: Branch: reuse existing widget or create it

nodes.name: Update Widget (Title)
nodes.description: Update existing widget name/description to use connector display names

nodes.name: Extract Updated Widget
nodes.description: Extract widget data from API response

nodes.name: Emit render_widget (existing)
nodes.description: Render existing widget in the conversation UI

nodes.name: Extract Created Widget
nodes.description: Extract widget data from API response

nodes.name: Emit render_widget (created)
nodes.description: Render newly created widget in the conversation UI
